versions.changelog:
Incremental sync and caching support added.

- Added incremental synchronization for events and todos to improve sync speed and efficiency.
- Introduced caching for sync state per account and calendar at `~/.config/mail-skills/caldav-cache/`.
- New `--force-refresh` option to bypass cache and force a full sync.
- Write operations now automatically invalidate the cache to ensure up-to-date data.
- Added scripts/cache.js and scripts/sync.js to implement caching and sync logic.

- Updated environment variable requirements in skill metadata (from CALDAV_SERVER_URL, CALDAV_USERNAME, CALDAV_PASSWORD to PROVIDER, USERNAME, PASSWORD)
- Adjusted primaryEnv from CALDAV_SERVER_URL to PROVIDER in metadata
- No changes to code or functionality; documentation and metadata update only

- Added direct install instructions for the related imap-smtp-email skill.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill itself.
- Documentation improvements for easier discovery and installation of related tools.

Initial release of caldav-sync.

- Calendar and todo management using the CalDAV protocol.
- Supports querying, creating, editing, and deleting events and todos.
- Free/busy queries and multi-account support.
- Compatible with Google Calendar, iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail, NetEase, and other standard CalDAV servers.
- Configuration via environment variables or shared config file.
- Command-line interface for all major CalDAV operations.
